summary: Frontend-only verification of WeekSchedule 'GESCHAFFT persists all week' fix. Seeded 2 test sessions for admin (day_index=2 completed 2026-07-06 within current week; day_index=3 completed 2026-06-27 previous week). Logged in as admin, opened /dashboard. Result: slot Mi (day_index=2) shows GESCHAFFT + green ✓ + green Dumbbell even though today is Tuesday - proving the badge persists past the completion day. Slot Do (day_index=3, older session) shows normal T3 label - previous-week session correctly excluded by startOfWeek boundary. No console errors. Seed data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: WeekSchedule.jsx line 80: filter `!s.day_index` uses truthy check - a plan_day with day_index=0 would be silently ignored. Current plans use 1-based indices so no impact today, but consider `s.day_index == null` for safety.
startOfWeek uses local browser time via new Date() + jsDayToMondayZero(getDay()) - correct behavior; auto-resets Monday 00:00 local as intended.
completedWeekdays Set is computed but never used in render - dead code, can be removed.

GESCHAFFT badge is anchored to plan_day.day_index (not to the actual weekday it was completed on) - this matches the requested behavior: the specific plan day stays marked done regardless of which weekday the user is currently viewing.
